provenance.created_for: Squash Engine ATP Tour 1990–2026 historical reference (not ATP-endorsed)
provenance.governing_scope: ATP Tour main circuit and ATP-operated Finals/Next Gen exhibition event only; no Grand Slams, ITF, ATP Challenger Tour or partner team competitions
notes: 2026 official main ATP Tour event roster plus a small set of verified historical top-tier events, not all ATP Tour tournaments 1990–2025.
2026 date/host fields are not assumed for earlier seasons.
Historical category identity remains stable while calendar editions and cancellations are unverified.
Current 2026 calendar lists a TBD slot; no fictitious persistent Series ID is created.
ATP 250 2026 list may differ between official updates: reconcile against the final event directory before calling it complete.
